name: Fashion Design
title: Fashion Design
intro: The fashion design roadmap: NIFT and other entrances, four years of design education, internships and industry careers.
glance: NIFT, NID DAT, CUET, institute tests

phases.title: Class 11–12 and early practice
phases.summary: Any stream; sketching and observation matter.
points: Fashion design admits students from any stream; Class 12 minimum marks vary by institute.
Practise sketching, colour combinations and design of garments.
Learn about fabrics, trends and fashion history.
Start a sketchbook and build a small portfolio.

phases.title: Entrance exams
phases.summary: NIFT, NID DAT, Pearl Academy and other institute tests.
points: NIFT entrance includes the General Ability Test (GAT) and the Creative Ability Test (CAT), followed by a situation test for some programmes; held once a year.
NID DAT tests design aptitude and creative problem solving in two stages.
Other institutes such as Pearl Academy, Symbiosis and private universities run their own tests; central universities may use CUET-UG.
Prepare drawing, colour, creativity and general knowledge.

phases.title: Foundation year
phases.summary: Drawing, design basics and fashion fundamentals.
points: Learn drawing, colour theory, design principles and textile basics.
Study fashion history and visual communication.
Try basic sewing, pattern and draping.
Take part in design workshops.

phases.title: Design, pattern and technology
phases.summary: Garment construction, textiles and fashion technology.
points: Learn pattern making, garment construction, textile design and fashion illustration.
Learn fashion software such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and CAD for fashion.
Study merchandising, fashion marketing and sustainability.
Complete collections and projects.

phases.title: Internships and graduation project
phases.summary: Industry placement and a collection of your own.
points: Do internships with design houses, export houses and retail brands.
Create a graduation collection and show it at the fashion show.
Build a portfolio and a professional online profile.
Many students receive campus placement offers.

phases.title: Careers and higher study
points: Roles: fashion designer, stylist, merchandiser, pattern maker, textile designer and brand manager.
Higher study: M.Des, MFM (Master of Fashion Management) or international programmes.
Entrepreneurship: your own label or boutique.
Employers: export houses, retail brands, design studios and the film and TV industry.
